title: Localized pure-tensor extensionality for Hom out of a total tensor
statement: Let (C,J) be a site, R a sheaf of commutative rings, K,L cochain complexes of R-module sheaves, X,N R-module sheaves, and p an integer. Put T=Tot(K tensor L), using [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves]. For a,b : X -> internal Hom(T^p,N), suppose the following holds. For every U, source section s in X(U), W -> U, integers i,j with i+j=p, and sections x in K^i(W), y in L^j(W), the localized maps a_U(s) and b_U(s) have equal values on the image in T^p(W) of x tensor y under the presheaf-to-sheaf tensor comparison and the (i,j) coproduct inclusion. Then a=b. Internal Hom and the presheaf-to-sheaf tensor comparison are those in [lem-sc-hom-tensor-degreewise] and [lem-pc-sheaf-modules-tensor-closed]. No chosen currying maps or complex morphisms are involved.

proof.text: Transpose a map X -> Hom(T,N) to a map T -> Hom(X,N): use the concrete presheaf tensor-Hom equivalence, the presheaf symmetry, and the same equivalence again. The transpose is a sheaf-module morphism because its target is the existing internal Hom sheaf. This operation is injective: forget to presheaf morphisms and cancel the two equivalences and the symmetry isomorphism. The private helpers reproduce the proved source tensor-Hom construction with independent site universes; each helper lemma explicitly binds C : Type u, Category.{v} C, the CommRingCat.{max u v} coefficient functor and its presheaves, distinguishing this generalization from the single-universe source lemmas; no unproved existence result is used.

Apply HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctor.hom_ext to the transposed maps. For each (i,j) summand, precompose with tensorObjIsoSheafification.inv and apply the injectivity of the sheafification adjunction homEquiv. Presheaf morphism extensionality and ModuleCat.MonoidalCategory.tensor_ext reduce equality to sectionwise pure tensors. This proves the tensor universal-property step directly rather than using the abstract tensorClosed statement.

Expand the transpose at U and W -> U. Its value is a at the base W, evaluated at the identity object of Over W, on the restriction of the tensor-summand image. Naturality of homTensorSectionMap followed by the summand inclusion moves that restriction inside the sectionwise tensor. The restriction of x tensor y is the tensor of the two restrictions. Apply the given hypothesis with base W, identity localization and these restricted sections. Injectivity of the transpose yields a=b.
